reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2, E3) discusses laser cladding, carburization under SPS, and laser melting deposition of HEAs, none of which provide specific support for pack aluminization of HfNbTaTiZr, Al2O3 scale formation, or the retention of mechanical properties. The key premises are entirely unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: Pack aluminization at ~900 °C can form a continuous, adherent Al2O3 scale on HfNbTaTiZr.
The Al2O3 scale will significantly enhance oxygen resistance at 1000 °C.
The treatment will not degrade the alloy's room-temperature ductility (8–16%).
The treatment will not degrade the alloy's high-temperature yield strength (~163–530 MPa).
Process optimization can mitigate scale spallation risks under thermal/mechanical loading.
